exposure: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) treatment during the first trimester of pregnancy
outcome: Final pregnancy outcomes (gestation length, bleeding during delivery, birth weight, gender of the newborn, mode of delivery)
cohort: The study included women diagnosed with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) who conceived following standard preconception care and voluntarily chose either a control group or an LMWH intervention group during the first month of pregnancy.
finding: LMWH treatment during early pregnancy significantly reduced the early pregnancy loss rate in women with PCOS (5.3% in the LMWH group vs. 26.5% in the control group).
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the mode of delivery between the LMWH and control groups.
